hero.kicker: A small hotel above the sea
hero.title: Stay where the tide sets the time.
hero.text: Twenty-two rooms carved into the cliff, a stone spa, long lunches on the terrace and the bay below.
hero.imageAlt: The hotel on the cliff above the bay

intro.text: Built from the island's own stone in 1962 and quietly restored, the house keeps its old rhythm: shutters open with the light, lunch runs long, and every room looks out to the water.

rooms.title: Twenty-two rooms, each facing the water.
rooms.hint: Scroll sideways through the rooms. Tap one for the details.

items.name: Sea View Suite
items.text: Linen, lime-washed walls and a balcony that opens straight onto the bay. Wake up to boats heading out.
items.features:
King bed
Private balcony
Rain shower
Nespresso and minibar

items.name: Garden Room
items.text: Terracotta floors and rattan under the olive trees, a few steps from the pool.
items.features:
Queen bed
Garden terrace
Walk-in shower
Olive grove views

items.name: Beam Loft
items.text: The old hayloft under hand-cut beams, with a freestanding bath beneath the skylight.
items.features:
King bed and day bed
Freestanding bath
Skylight
Sitting area

items.name: Cliff Villa
items.text: Two bedrooms, a stone terrace and a plunge pool on the edge of the cliff. Sunset is yours.
items.features:
Two bedrooms
Private plunge pool
Outdoor dining
Butler on call

items.name: Stone Spa
items.text: A candlelit pool cut into the rock, treatments with island salt and oils, and nowhere to be.

items.name: Terrace Kitchen
items.text: Fish from the morning boats, vegetables from our garden and long tables under the lights.

items.name: Hidden Coves
items.text: Our wooden boat takes you to coves you can only reach from the water. Snorkels and lunch on board.

amenities.items:
Breakfast on the terrace

Stone spa

E-bikes to borrow

Airport transfers
